* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabiim: Starship Hangar (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 26 December 2025: “'''Light Side:''' While a Jedi survivor present, you lose no Force to Visage Of The Emperor. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may deploy from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) (or deploy from Lost Pile) Grand Inquisitor here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Jabiim: Starship Hangar]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Jabiim: Starship Hangar]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Jabiim: Starship Hangar”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
